simple.meaning: the swift , a kind of swallow
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דְּרוֹר (H1866) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דְּרוֹר (dᵉrôwr) means the swift , a kind of swallow First listed occurrence: Prov 26 2.

definitions.short: the swift , a kind of swallow
definitions.full: H1866. deror II. דְּרוֺר noun feminine Psa 84:4 swallow 84:4 (|| צִמּוֺר ), Che (q. v.) makes simile of quiet, peace, security, and supplies ellipsis; in simile, Prov 26:2 לָעוּף כַּדְּרוֺר לָנוּד כַּצִמּוֺר (of groundless curse, which does not alight, i.e. is not fulfilled).
definitions.rootNote: the same as 1865 , applied to a bird;
